description: Work out the level monthly lease expense of an operating lease whose rent changes over the term (escalations, free-rent months), and the difference between that expense and the cash paid, year by year, with the running balance of accrued (or prepaid) rent. Send either steps (a list of rent periods in order, each with months and monthly_rent) or base_monthly_rent + term_months (+ annual_escalation_percent, + free_rent_months). Get back the total rent over the term, the level monthly expense, and for each lease year the cash paid, the expense, the difference and the cumulative difference. Straight-line convention: total fixed rent over the term divided evenly by the months (ASC 842-20-25-6 operating lease cost; ASC 840-20-25-1). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/straight-line-lease). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

annual_escalation_percent.description: Rent goes up by this percent each lease anniversary (every 12 months), compounding. Default 0.

base_monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent in the first rent-paying year (with term_months).

free_rent_months.description: Months of free rent at the start (inside the term). Default 0.

steps.description: Rent periods in order from lease start, e.g. [{months:12, monthly_rent:1000}, {months:12, monthly_rent:1100}]. Total months must be 360 or fewer.

monthly_rent.description: Fixed rent per month in this period (0 for free rent).

months.description: How many months this rent applies.
